notes.title: 1.0.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
An overhaul to all bullets. Now they all have inner glowing effect, more in line with general SHMUPs.

Coming next:
Rework of pretty much all the other visual parts, including bosses, self, background and font.

tags.feature: An overhaul to all bullets. Now they all have inner glowing effect, more in line with general SHMUPs.

notes.title: 1.0.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Now Boss difficulty multipliers also affect all addons. Previously they don't.
Since there're some bosses using special bullets (e.g. 3:arrow, 14:megabomb) that designed to have a fixed frequency, multipliers for them feel much more impactful now as they scale all the others, not only the normal bullets from the boss.

Early game difficulty reduced. Same when reaching rank 50.
More bosses and addons unlocked at rank 40.
Reworked some bosses a bit to make them less noisy during certain phases.
Nerfed addon 7:Fixed Generator, 8:Sweeping Generator, 40:Railway
